failure.title: Offline-state browser assertion used an ambiguous broad-text locator
failure.note: The production offline-state journey retained seven exact artifacts after the expected state rendered but a broad text regex matched both its heading and supporting copy under strict locator semantics.
failure.diagnosis: The product presented the correct accessible offline state, but the test searched all text with /offline|could not reach/ and therefore resolved two visible elements instead of one exact semantic target.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
